description.value:
The Masamune is not just a rifle but a work of fine art. Designed in the 50's and manufactured from the best, most resilient materials, the Masamune is great for all conditions, while also being surprisingly light. Every single one of the Masamune's elements, down to the tiniest screws and bolts, were quality-ensured by a legion of Arasaka engineers – and you can feel it. Not only is it light to handle, but it's intuitive to use – even for first-time users. And to top it all off, it comes with state-of-the-art software and holographic sights and a three-round burst mode.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 24 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst when fired. Whenever this weapon would ablate armor, it ablates 1 additional SP (2 SP Normal / 3 SP Armor-Piercing). This weapon will not fire if there are less than 3 rounds in the magazine.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
